feature_specification.objective: Upgrade the NSE/BSE Episodic Pivot screener into an auditable EOD trader workflow. It must explain catalyst quality, price acceptance, tradability, risk, and historical evidence. It is research/planning software and must not present scores as investment advice or guaranteed returns.

constraints.constraint: Preserve existing Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQLite development, APScheduler, Jinja, and vanilla JavaScript architecture.
Keep existing /api/ep/* responses backward compatible; add response fields rather than removing or renaming fields.
Do not destructively rewrite existing ep_features or ep_watchlist history.
Do not add paid data vendors, broker execution, or new ML dependencies without explicit approval.
First trader release is EOD-only. Intraday signals remain feature-flagged off.

risk_defaults.rule: Defaults are editable safety templates. Never size a position without an explicit account-risk setting.

authoritative_data.fo_eligibility: NSE daily Equity Derivatives underlyings/contracts data; do not use a static inferred list.
authoritative_data.surveillance: NSE ASM/GSM notices and lists; also check BSE equivalent notices for dual-listed securities.
authoritative_data.free_float: Estimate from latest NSE shareholding-pattern filing: public shareholding multiplied by paid-up shares. Always expose filing date.
authoritative_data.provenance_rule: Persist source URL, source published time, effective date, fetch time, and source status.

catalyst_overrides.audit_fields: original_value, override_value, reason, evidence_url, actor, reviewer, created_at, reviewed_at

trade_ownership.trade_journal_owns: actual_entry, actual_stop, targets, quantity, status, exit, pnl, realised_r
trade_ownership.rule: Journal creation copies an immutable EP snapshot and never mutates episode facts.

entity.name: ep_episode
entity.fields: id, symbol, exchange, catalyst_id, event_timestamp, source_url, event_type, original_ohlcv, original_scores, score_version, original_stop_price, materiality_inputs, data_quality

entity.name: ep_episode_daily_state
entity.fields: close, current_score, trailing_stop, setup_state, trigger_type, r_achieved, reason_codes, freshness

api_contract.additive_response_fields: quality, freshness, coverage, episode, risk_plan, score_version, setup_state
api_contract.validation: Return 400 for malformed input and 422 for a valid request that cannot produce an executable risk plan.

requirements.requirement: Freeze original stop, catalyst date, original EP-day fields, and original score/version.
Add a named trailing-stop rule that only ratchets in the favourable direction.
Use one centrally configured confidence vocabulary across service, UI, alerts, and tests.
Expose feature date, pipeline completion time, and source status.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Nightly refresh cannot change original stop or original episode facts.
Trailing stop is monotonic by trade direction.

requirements.requirement: Create a reusable TradabilityAssessment with explicit PASS/WARN/FAIL reasons.
Default long gates: ₹200 Cr market cap, ₹20 Cr 20-day median traded value, ₹5 Cr EP-day traded value, and ₹30 price.
Separate earnings, announcement, abnormal-volume, delayed-trigger, and theme discovery queues.
Show coverage counts for scanned, discovered, enriched, excluded, and failed-source records.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A liquid material earnings event below 3x relative volume can be discovered.
Failed tradability gates prevent auto-alerting and show reasons.

requirements.requirement: Build CatalystAssessment with source provenance, event timing, extraction confidence, materiality inputs, and auditable overrides.
Require a source URL and timestamp before catalyst status is PASS.
Show measurable materiality for results, orders, capex, turnarounds, governance, and themes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every PASS catalyst links to evidence and explains materiality.
Unknown or incomplete input is WARN, not fabricated certainty.

requirements.requirement: Calculate price acceptance and context from EOD data: gap, close location, range/ATR, relative volume, delivery, moving averages, base levels, breadth, and sector RRG.
Assign exactly one setup state: ACTIONABLE_NOW, WAIT_FOR_TRIGGER, WAIT_FOR_PULLBACK, AVOID, or TRIGGERED.
Define an intraday-compatible contract but do not enable VWAP or opening-range rules.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each candidate has a state and reason codes.
Detail UI shows entry trigger, invalidation, and why-now/why-wait explanation.

requirements.requirement: Generate entry zone, original stop, trailing rule, risk per share, quantity, maximum chase price, and R levels.
Create a journal draft when an EP triggers and link it to the immutable episode.
Block actionable status when required risk-plan values are absent or invalid.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Journal owns realised trade facts; EP episode owns original signal facts.

requirements.requirement: Retain explainable rules as baseline and train outcome models only on real, timestamp-valid history.
Use EP-type-specific, walk-forward evaluation and net-of-cost execution assumptions.
Include brokerage, taxes, slippage, gap stops, timing, cash, and overlapping positions in backtests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No model replaces the baseline without predeclared out-of-sample improvement.

requirements.requirement: Add state, quality, freshness, and risk to the EP command-center table.
Alert only on state transitions and deduplicate per episode.
Make detail reads side-effect-free; run enrichment in background jobs.
Escape third-party text before browser rendering.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A trader can choose act, wait, or avoid from the detail view in under 60 seconds.

testing.unit: Scoring, gates, state transitions, sizing, stop monotonicity, override audit.
testing.integration: Pipeline idempotency, persistence, API contracts, journal linkage.
testing.backtest: Event timing, stop gaps, simultaneous target/stop, costs, slippage, walk-forward splits.
testing.e2e: Actionable, wait, avoid, triggered, alert, and journal workflows.
testing.security: HTML-bearing external event fixture must not execute in client.

boundaries.always: Use parameterized persistence, source provenance, freshness indicators, and tests for each phase.
boundaries.ask_first: Add a paid vendor, ML dependency, database-engine change, public API version, broker integration, or automatic execution.
boundaries.never: Use synthetic data for production scoring, widen initial stops silently, overwrite episode facts, or render untrusted text as HTML.

remaining_open_questions.question: Which role/authentication mechanism authorises shared catalyst overrides?
Which minute-bar provider is approved before intraday functionality is enabled?
Which migration tool will create immutable episode and daily-state tables?
